note: Flatten the ten Forsworn missions to dialog / start_battle / dialog / win_quest. Zero forced travel. Balance untouched: content.reward re-asserted verbatim, all node rewards were already zero.

data.name: Chalk and Corner
data.description: Four corner stones. Each one has a chalk mark. Record what is on each stone and the hour you saw it. Do not scrub anything. Do not add anything.
data.successDescription: The chalk marks were a schedule, not a boundary.

objectives.description:
Fresh chalk on the corner stone. Three strokes, angled north.

Someone is marking routes through our streets.
A figure crouches to add a fourth stroke and finds you already there.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The marks come off with water. Whoever taught them the code is still out there.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: Protection
data.description: A grain merchant has been paying someone every eighth day for two years. He reported it last week because the price went up. He has never been given a name. Stand three nights at his yard and make sure nobody collects.
data.successDescription: Whoever runs it never visits the yard and never meets his own men. A loose stone in a wall is the only place he has to be.

objectives.description:
The noodle stand pays someone every week. It is not the village.

The owner will not say the name out loud.
The collector arrives on schedule and reaches for the box.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The stand keeps its coin this week. Next week is a different question.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Empty Contract
data.description: A dead courier was carrying a strange contract. It names a place, a night, and a price, but it does not say what the job is. The price is far too high for a simple beating. The night is tonight.
data.successDescription: Nobody was planning a robbery. Someone was paid to time the patrols, and that number will sell to anybody.

objectives.description:
A bounty contract on the board with the name cut out of it.

Everything else is filled in. Rank, sector, payment.
You find the target exactly where the blank contract said they would be.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: Someone wanted this one taken without wanting it written down.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Waystation
data.description: The keeper of the pass waystation is going home to open it again. The posting says: guard her from bandits, two days up the pass road. The pay is low, even for C rank.
data.successDescription: The posting said bandits. It was never bandits.

objectives.description:
The road shelter has been used. Rations, bedding, a cold fire pit.

None of it is village issue.
They come back for the cache and do not expect it to be occupied.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The waystation is ours again. There are others on this road.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: Nothing to Report
data.description: A warehouse clerk is carrying two years of bonded collection sheets to a village audit that sits at first light. The people who would rather those books did not arrive are trained. Safehouse to records hall, before dawn.
data.successDescription: The books went onto the audit table at first light. They name a broker, a bank and eleven dates, and not one member of the Forsworn, because the clerk has never met one.

objectives.description:
The patrol log reads clean for six straight nights.

The sector is not clean. You have seen it.
Halfway along the route, you learn why the log stayed empty.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The log was not wrong. It was written by someone being paid to write it.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Loud Way
data.description: Eleven crates signed into a bonded warehouse in four months and never signed out. Nobody reports a theft, and nobody pays four months of bond fees on goods they never touch. Get inside, learn what the building is for, get out.
data.successDescription: The warehouse was never storing anything. It is a place where two people who refuse to meet can hand something over without ever being in the room at the same time.

objectives.description:
They burned the granary in daylight with the doors open.

Quiet was never the point.
One of them stayed behind to be seen. That was always the assignment.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: They wanted witnesses. Now the village has one who fought back.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: Old Ghost
data.description: An old Bingo Book entry, faded and worn, pinned to the mission board with a fresh brief. Old Ghost. Resurfaced after years in hiding. Once ran an ANBU cell in this village.
data.successDescription: Four squads have filed this report. The entry is still open.

objectives.description:
An old bounty contract, faded, pinned beside a fresh brief.

Old Ghost ran an ANBU cell here once. He is back.
He does not run. He waited for someone from the village to come.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: He knew every name on the wall. That is why they sent him away.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Long Winter
data.description: Three people have died in nine days, in three districts, with nothing in common except that all five of them signed one authorisation during the border winter. Two names are left on that page, and one of them is yours to protect.
data.successDescription: The village bought four convoys of grain across a closed border and paid for three. Not because anyone decided to cheat him. Because the paperwork was built so that nobody would ever have to know his name.

objectives.description:
Winter Crow has not moved camp in four months.

She is not hiding. She is waiting for the village to get tired.
She stands up as you enter the clearing, unhurried, already reaching.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: She outlasted three hunters before you. She did not outlast the fourth.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Tenth Name
data.description: A page taken off a body lists ten entries. Nine are copied out of our own Bingo Book in a hand that is not ours. The tenth has no name on it, only a service number with this village's prefix and a date eight months out. Copies are in transit.
data.successDescription: Nobody infiltrated anything. The four fields on every entry are public record, printed by this village about its own people and pinned to a wall.

objectives.description:
Nine names on the Forsworn list are crossed out.

The tenth has no crossing and no face.
The one who answers to the tenth name meets you without introducing themselves.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The list is closed. Nobody is sure the tenth name was ever a person.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: Three Rounds
data.description: A four person squad went to watch a bonded handover on the east road and has missed two signal windows. Four B rank shinobi have gone quiet inside our own border.
data.successDescription: He was never unbeatable. He was expensive, and he could not afford himself for longer than a minute.

objectives.description:
Pale Fang has beaten two village hunters and let both walk home.

He sent word that he will give a third the same courtesy.
He salutes before he moves. He means it, and it does not slow him down.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: He let the first two go to make sure a third would come.
Contract closed.
Go again.
